summary: Vendor bank details updated in AP portal, payment auto-flagged as potential fraud and blocked
description:
Issue summary:
A vendor (BrightVector GmbH) updated their bank account details in the AP vendor portal at 2026-03-09 14:12 CET. The change hit the nightly payment run and the payment engine automatically flagged the transaction as a potential fraud due to: a change in IBAN country code compared to the vendor master record and a mismatched remittance email. As a result the scheduled payment (PayRun ID PR-20260310-77) was moved to a manual review queue and not released.

Impact:
- One scheduled supplier payment of EUR 48,320 remains blocked and unpaid as of 2026-03-10 morning payroll cutoffs.
- AP team cannot proceed with vendor settlement; vendor has escalated to their sales ops and Redwood Finance.
- Potential late-payment fees and supply disruption risk if not cleared before next business day.

Environment:
- Production AP system (Payments Engine v3.8.1) integrated with Stripe Treasury connector for EU bank rails.
- Affected vendor record: BrightVector GmbH (Vendor ID V-99821).
- Affected payment: PR-20260310-77, amount EUR 48,320, currency EUR, originating from EU pool eu-west.

Steps to reproduce / Observed behavior:
1) Vendor submitted bank update via vendor portal on 2026-03-09 14:12 CET.
2) Vendor record updated in AP master (change captured in audit log entry U-82421).
3) Nightly payment run picks up outstanding payments; logic checks vendor bank history and flags if IBAN country or BIC changed in last 30 days.
4) Payment engine flagged PR-20260310-77 as 'safety_fraud_check' and moved to manual_review queue.
5) Finance ops received automated alert but the queue owner role was unassigned due to on-call rotation mismatch.

Expected behavior:
- Bank detail changes less than 7 days old should require a manual verification step but not automatically block already approved payments if the vendor has active contracts and earlier remittance history matches.

Actual behavior:
- Payment was blocked automatically and not released; on-call finance ops did not receive a direct page due to missing escalation mapping.

Attachments:
- Payment run log excerpt: payments_log_20260310.txt (referenced in logs below).
- Vendor portal audit snapshot: vendor_audit_V-99821_20260309.json
impact: One high-value vendor payment blocked, risk of supplier disruption and late fees; manual intervention required before next banking cutoff.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Edit vendor banking details in vendor portal changing IBAN country or BIC.
2. Trigger nightly payrun or simulate with PR job.
3. Observe auto-flag rule 'safety_fraud_check' in payments engine and movement to manual_review queue.

investigation_notes:
Initial triage by Finance Ops (Aisha): confirmed vendor changed IBAN from DE to AT; previous payments 2025-11..2026-02 used DE IBAN. Payment engine rule 'safety_fraud_check' created by payments team in 2025-09 after a past fraud incident to block cross-country IBAN changes for 30 days.
Engineering (Marco): inspected rule config in repo payments/rules/safety_rules.yaml (commit a7c3f2e). Rule currently applies to all vendors regardless of vendor verification status.
Ops discovered escalation mapping for manual_review queue is missing for eu-west on-call group (missing entry in PagerDuty integration: service key finance-payments-manual-review-eu).
Hypothesis: conservative rule + missing on-call escalation caused the blockage and the alert was not paged to a human.
comments: 2026-03-10 08:15 - Aisha Patel (Finance Ops): Created ticket after vendor escalation. Contacted vendor via vendor portal; they confirm new IBAN is legitimate and provided a scanned bank confirmation (attached). Requested urgent manual review.

2026-03-10 09:02 - Marco Diaz (Payments Eng): Confirmed the safety_fraud_check rule is active and will flag IBAN country changes for 30 days. Will scope a temporary rule override for verified vendors pending ops sign-off.
2026-03-10 10:12 - Lydia Chen (Risk): Asked for vendor KYC artifacts and whether the vendor is on an approved vendor list. Vendor has passed KYC in 2025-10; latest invoice history is normal.

2026-03-10 11:00 - Marco Diaz: Opened PR #488-payments-temporary-override to allow manual release when vendor verification_status == 'verified' and change_age_days < 14. Linked in related_github_prs. Marked as emergency change; requires Finance Ops approval to merge and backfill release.

2026-03-11 07:45 - Aisha Patel: Performed manual verification checklist and approved release for PR-20260310-77. Finance Ops requested that Payments Eng run backfill to release other queued items for verified vendors.
resolution: Temporary manual release performed for PR-20260310-77 after vendor KYC verification and bank confirmation. Emergency code change (PR #488-payments-temporary-override) merged to allow verified vendors with recent bank updates to be eligible for release after manual sign-off. PagerDuty escalation mapping for manual_review eu-west service created (service key added). Follow-up actions scheduled: adjust rule to exclude verified vendors and add 2-step automated verification flags; add audit metric to detect blocked payments older than 6 hours.
notes: Follow-up: schedule a post-incident review with Payments Eng, Risk, and Finance Ops to tune fraud rule thresholds and improve on-call coverage. Create a metric on Console to alert when manual_review queue length > 5 for > 30 minutes.
